Here's the basics of how I travel the world at about $800 / month (I am currently on month 8 of 12 month goal for this year)

$20/wk on groceries seems pretty unlikely in almost any economy. First of all, most hostels don't have a place for you to do any cooking, and even if you're subsisting on basic pasta, a can of pasta sauce (good for 2 or 3 meals) is $5, the pasta itself is about $5, and you're looking at perhaps 3 meals out of that $20.

Also unlikely is bus transportation at that rate. First of all, buses are only continental; you can't take a bus around the world. And even so, a bus is typically $30+ between EU member states at least.

Finally couchsurfing? I don't think that traveling the world on $800/mo counts when you're essentially freeloading on friend's generosity.
